newsitem.title: USA: AmEx launches credit card in Argentina.
newsitem.headline: AmEx launches credit card in Argentina.

text.p: American Express Co said Tuesday it launched a new credit card in Argentina.

The company said American Express Argentina set a "highly competitive" interest rate of 3.18 percent a month in pesos (38.70 annual percentage rate in pesos) and 1.64 percent a month in dollars (19.6 annual percentage rate in dollars). A spokesmen said cardmembers have the option of paying in either pesos or dollars.
American Express said it already offers in Argentina its traditional charge cards where outstanding balances must be paid in full each month.
American Express said the card being launched in Argentina is its first credit card product in Latin America.
